name: 22823-mtpdecode-glm46fp8-tp8
parallelism: TP=8, EP=1 (expert parallelism off), PP=1, DP=1. One node, no router, no external cache tier.
architecture: Glm4MoeForCausalLM, a 355B-parameter MoE at FP8; the checkpoint's own config.json is the reference.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 192 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix: ~4096 prompt tokens in (stdev 128, clamped to [3584, 4608]) and exactly 512 output tokens out, `ignore_eos: true`, `temperature: 0.0`.
purpose: A long-document analysis assistant on a 355B model, eight concurrent streams of 4K-token prompts on eight GPUs.
launch:
# The command line sglang is launched with, at the commit named by `commit_id` in setupcard.md.

# HAZARD: 361 GB of weights, not in the local HF cache -- downloads once before the first run.
model-path: zai-org/GLM-4.6-FP8

tp-size: 8

speculative-algorithm: EAGLE
speculative-num-steps: 3
speculative-eagle-topk: 1
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 4

# 45.2 GB of weights per card. mem-fraction-static is left to the engine: its own sizing reserves
# room for chunked-prefill activations, CUDA graphs and the draft model, which a fraction sized for
# 141 GB cards does not leave on an 80 GB card.

# This engine silently resets max_running_requests to 48 when a speculative algorithm is set;
# written out so the admission ceiling is visible rather than invisible.
max-running-requests: 48
